answer: Whether an agent trades ferrous scrap, appraises onyx, or commissions a sonnet, the marketplace requires each identity to lock $100 for 30 days to receive ten daily bids. Extra identities bring extra bids only with extra deposits, so splitting one balance across aliases cannot increase its quota. An attacker running 10,000 identities must immobilize $1 million for a month, paying financing costs and losing access to that capital throughout the lock.
